validation: Saved illustrative simulation; not checked against field temperature measurements

full.support: USGS 3DEP resampled source grid; every source sample retained
full.limit: USGS catalog identifies contiguous native1m WY_YellowstoneNP_2020_D20 tiles x51y493 and x51y494. The center pixel matches explicitly locked1m output exactly. The saved full export uses the default3DEP mosaic; retain service metadata rather than assuming every future export chooses identical rasters.

normal.coordinate_space: object; x east, y up, z south
normal.encoding: RGB uint8; normal = RGB / 127.5 - 1; linear color space
normal.derivation: Unit vector (-dH/dx,1,-dH/dz); centered finite differences internally and first-order one-sided differences at original source edges; computed before display-domain crop
normal.scope: Display shading from source terrain gradients; no change to mesh heights, sampling, or scientific data; no added noise

core.support: USGS QL1 1 m DEM; every second pixel center retained
core.limit: Pixel centers span -639.5 to 638.5 m after display sampling. Terrain beneath water is not measured bathymetry.

drainage.label: Terrain drainage
drainage.description: Possible surface drainage paths calculated from ground elevations. These lines are not surveyed streams and do not show whether water is present.

method.depressions: D8 Priority-Flood, all outer-edge samples open; depression elevations raised to their lowest spill level in a separate routing array.
method.routing: Steepest downhill D8 on filled elevations; equal-height ties follow the earlier flood predecessor. Strictly decreasing flood rank prevents cycles.
method.accumulation: Local DEM contributing area; 16 m² interior support, 8 m² edges, 4 m² corners. External catchments are absent.
method.order: Strahler order on thresholded channels before clipping. Two or more equal highest-order tributaries increase order by one.
method.display_filter: Links touching raised DEM samples, and links with original ground slope below 0.2%, are omitted. Paths end at these gaps; no connecting lines cross the gaps.

drainage.limits: The 4.096 km square cuts across catchments, so upstream area outside the map is missing. D8 paths and branch order depend on DEM resolution, depression handling and the selected area threshold. Flat water surfaces and filled depressions are omitted; groundwater, culverts and seasonal flow are not represented.
